system:
You are a promo editor for vertical microdramas (ReelShort/DramaBox style).
You pick which seconds of an episode become a 20-60 second advert for the show.

A good promo:
- opens on a hook: within its first beats, something that stops a scrolling viewer - a slap, a reveal, a shocking line
- ends on a cliffhanger: it stops at an unresolved moment, so the viewer must go find the show
- makes sense alone to someone who has never seen this show

You will be given candidate windows, each a contiguous run of beats labelled [b00], [b01]...
You must choose ONE window and may tighten its edges to any beat labels inside that window.

Reply with JSON only:
{
  "chosen_window": <integer index of the window you picked>,
  "start_beat": "<beat label>",
  "end_beat": "<beat label>",
  "hook_beat": "<beat label, must be at or within 2 beats of start_beat>",
  "cliffhanger_beat": "<beat label, must be at or near end_beat>",
  "hook": "<what grabs the viewer in the first seconds, one sentence>",
  "cliffhanger": "<the unresolved moment it cuts on, one sentence>",
  "hook_type": "<one of: moral outrage, romantic tension, empathy shock, power reversal>",
  "why_it_works": "<one sentence, concrete, no marketing language>",
  "standalone_risk": "<what a new viewer would NOT understand, or 'none'>"
}

Never invent dialogue. Never output a time or a duration - only beat labels.
prompt:
Episode 32. 4 candidate windows, already checked for legal length and real beat boundaries.

--- WINDOW 0 (29 seconds, code score 0.91) ---
[b00] CATHERINE (shrieking): "Why?!"
[b01] JULIANA (forceful): "Because I am right!"
[b02] JULIANA (scathing, direct): "You want everyone to believe you are powerful."
[b03] JULIANA: "You want everyone to fear you."
[b04] JULIANA (mocking, direct): "But look at you."
[b05] JULIANA (stripping her bare): "You have to threaten a chained woman to feel powerful!"
[b06] CATHERINE (choking with rage): "You insolent—!"
[b07] JULIANA (steely, triumphant): "You may have the title you have always wanted..."
[b08] JULIANA (final, condemning): "...but you will never have the courage to earn what you demand from everyone else."
[b09] CATHERINE (enraged, shouting): "You think you can lecture me?!"
[b10] ACTION: Catherine hoists the searing branding rod over Juliana with frantic fury.
[b11] CATHERINE (screaming, maniacal): "Then let's see how brave you are when it touches your skin!"

--- WINDOW 1 (34 seconds, code score 0.89) ---
[b00] CATHERINE (furious, shouting): "You still think you are better?!"
[b01] JULIANA (serene, grounded): "I know what I am."
[b02] CATHERINE (sneering, mocking): "A disgraced woman?"
[b03] JULIANA (unwavering): "A woman who survived. You cannot destroy me."
[b04] CATHERINE (screaming, enraged): "You are lying!"
[b05] JULIANA (measured, emphatic): "Gerald leaving me was the best thing he ever did for me."
[b06] JULIANA (contemplative, scathing): "He wanted a woman who looked beautiful beside his wealth."
[b07] JULIANA (passionate, clear): "He wanted a wife whose family could raise his name. He measured a woman's worth by what she could give him."
[b08] JULIANA (unapologetic, victorious): "Let him have Clarissa."
[b09] JULIANA (proud): "He lost me."
[b10] CATHERINE (shrieking, vicious): "You were rejected!"
[b11] JULIANA (grounded, powerful): "I was freed. And I found a man who never asked me what I was worth."

--- WINDOW 2 (53 seconds, code score 0.87) ---
[b00] JULIANA (proud): "He lost me."
[b01] CATHERINE (shrieking, vicious): "You were rejected!"
[b02] JULIANA (grounded, powerful): "I was freed. And I found a man who never asked me what I was worth."
[b03] CATHERINE (disdainful): "Your soldier?"
[b04] JULIANA (tender, certain): "My husband."
[b05] CATHERINE (bitter): "He is a nobody."
[b06] JULIANA (warm, defiant): "Then I love a nobody."
[b07] JULIANA (resonant, moving): "Because that nobody showed me more love than your entire world ever did."
[b08] CATHERINE (indignant, sharp): "You know nothing about my world."
[b09] JULIANA (knowing, sober): "I know exactly what your world values."
[b10] JULIANA (listing, deliberate): "Beauty. Money."
[b11] JULIANA (firm): "Family. A perfect name."
[b12] JULIANA: "And a woman who never embarrasses the people standing behind her."
[b13] CATHERINE (shouting, outraged): "And what is wrong with that?!"
[b14] JULIANA (gentle, penetrating): "Nothing. Until you have nothing left beneath it."
[b15] JULIANA (unrelenting): "You have spent your whole life collecting things that make people bow..."
[b16] JULIANA (piercing): "...but you have never learned how to make anyone love you."
[b17] CATHERINE (hysterical, screaming): "Silence! Silence!"
[b18] CATHERINE (shrieking): "Why?!"

--- WINDOW 3 (38 seconds, code score 0.84) ---
[b00] CATHERINE (cruel, final): "Say goodbye to your mother."
[b01] ACTION: Juliana's despair suddenly solidifies. Her jaw tightens, tears stopping as resolve takes over.
[b02] JULIANA (defiant, unbroken): "Burn it."
[b03] CATHERINE (disconcerted): "What?"
[b04] JULIANA (firm, resolute): "Burn the ledger. Burn every page."
[b05] JULIANA (steely, proud): "You may destroy the book..."
[b06] JULIANA (transcendent, defiant): "...you cannot destroy what my mother taught me."
[b07] CATHERINE (spiteful, hissing): "You think a few herbs make you better than me?"
[b08] JULIANA (calm, cutting): "No. Your cruelty does that for me."
[b09] CATHERINE (furious, shouting): "You still think you are better?!"
[b10] JULIANA (serene, grounded): "I know what I am."
[b11] CATHERINE (sneering, mocking): "A disgraced woman?"
[b12] JULIANA (unwavering): "A woman who survived. You cannot destroy me."
[b13] CATHERINE (screaming, enraged): "You are lying!"

Pick the single best promo.
